title: test: debug flag turns the display rate request off

commit.merge_subject: merge: test: debug flag turns the display rate request off

description: Debug builds only: a files/debug-no-display-rate marker (run-as touch) skips DisplayRateApply.begin so playback smoothness can be A/B compared with and without the refresh-rate request. Interleaved device result on one 4K30 MCRAW clip at the 1280 tier, four runs each: request on, 8.9% dropped frames and p95 frame gap 61.0 ms; request off, 6.8% and 59.4 ms. No measurable benefit on this clip.
changed: test: debug flag turns the display rate request off
